hero.title: One property, three ways to invest
hero.lead: One published fee grid, the same for every investor. What changes from one card to the next is the ticket.
hero.beta: Closed beta, approved by hand. A prototype with demo money only: nothing is invested.

rate.D5: {rate} of the gain above a {hurdle}/yr hurdle

notPaid.title: What you don't pay

syndication.title: Sellers pay the syndication fee
syndication.text: {rate} of the capital raised, charged to the seller or developer, and only if the raise closes.

structuring.title: Operators pay the structuring fee
structuring.text: {rate} of the capital raised, charged to the operator at lease signature.

entry.title: No entry fee for you
entry.text: Subscribing costs {rate}. If a raise fails, the escrow bank returns your money in full.

notPaid.footnote: Seller and operator fees never reduce your return. Fees are a disclosed service charge, never netted against a promised yield.
